name: peeps-action
description: Runs your Playwright, pytest or Appium tests in your own CI and reports the results to Peeps.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/reporter.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/reporter.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/appium-reporter.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/appium-reporter.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/appium-collect.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/appium-collect.mjs --log-level=warning
